{{Quote|If you can't figure out this basic poodoo, just get off the holonet before mommy takes away your datapad and the space slugs game card you saved up your allowance to buy.|myrlinator, responding to wampa1 in a post on the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="destabilization">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040105|text=Destabilization}}</ref>}}
A '''space slugs game card''' was a type of game card. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[myrlinator]] made reference to a [[Exogorth/Legends|space slugs]] game card in a post on the [[Cularin holonet node]] that criticized fellow slicer [[wampa1]].<ref name="destabilization" />
